hierarchy.data_numbers: text-sm sm:text-base font-mono font-semibold tracking-tight text-white

typography.instruction: Use IBM Plex Mono (tabular nums) exclusively for chip amounts, pot sizes, bankrolls, and timers. Outfit for all major headings. Manrope for general reading text.

colors.instruction: Never use generic violet or bright purple gradients. Focus on deep charcoal/obsidian backgrounds to let the green felt and gold accents pop. Add subtle radial glow (15-20% opacity) behind the table.

textures.felt: Use CSS radial gradients mixed with a subtle SVG noise overlay for the poker table felt.
textures.grain: Apply a 2-3% opacity black/white noise overlay across the entire application background.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped, bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#18181B] font-semibold, hover:brightness-110, transition-colors duration-200. Used for major calls to action like 'Deposit' or 'Join Table'.
buttons.action_panel: Sharp or slightly rounded rectangles for game actions (Fold, Call, Raise). Fold should be dark/subdued (bg-[#27272A] text-[#A1A1AA]), Call is neutral-light (bg-[#71717A] text-white), Raise is accented (bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#18181B]).
buttons.preset_bet: Small, dense chips/buttons above the slider (Min, 1/2, Pot, All-in) using font-mono.

cards.style: Clean white background with sharp contrasting pips. Large index numbers for readability. Use standard red (#E92C2C) for Hearts/Diamonds, dark charcoal (#1A1A1D) for Spades/Clubs. Subtle shadow-md to pop off the green felt. Build these using pure HTML/Tailwind for crispness.

chips.style: Stacked CSS/HTML circles. Outer dashed border or striped gradients to simulate chip edges. font-mono text for chip values. Colors based on denomination (e.g., Red 5, Green 25, Black 100). Use Framer Motion to animate chip movement to the pot.

seats.style: Circular avatars. If active, surround with a gold ring. If it's their turn, the ring acts as a shrinking timer (SVG circle with stroke-dashoffset). Provide a small name/stack badge below the avatar using font-mono bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-md p-1.

lobby_grid.style: High-density data view. Rows or Bento-grid cards showing Table Name, Stakes, Players (e.g. 4/6), Waitlist. Use 'Crystal Glass' style (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md) with a subtle gold_trim border on hover.

lobby.structure: Sidebar navigation (left) + Dense main grid. Grid should be grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-4 or gap-6.

poker_table.structure: Heroic centered layout. The main area is a massive flex or grid container centering an oval/pill-shaped 'table' element (e.g., w-[90%] max-w-5xl aspect-[2/1] rounded-[999px]). Seats are positioned absolutely around this oval. Community cards are in the absolute center. Pot size is below community cards.

action_panel.structure: Fixed at the bottom right or spanning the bottom. Flex container with the slider on top, action buttons below. Padding should be dense (p-4) to maximize table space. Use a dark backdrop-blur panel.

motion.cards: Framer motion for dealing: layoutId or initial={scale: 0, x: center} animate={scale: 1, x: position}. 3D flip effect (rotateY) when revealing community cards.
motion.chips: Slide from seat to pot (x/y translation) with a slight staggering effect.
motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-0.5 and shadow-glow_gold on interactive buttons/table cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the dark felt and charcoal backgrounds meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Gold text against charcoal should be checked for readability.
accessibility.test_ids: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='fold-button', data-testid='table-lobby-card').

felt_texture.description: Solid green textured background for use in marketing hero or overlay

gold_chips.description: Stacked yellow casino chips for marketing/bankroll visuals

playing_cards.description: Scattered playing cards for hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for the poker table (dealing cards, moving chips, player turn indicators).

Build the poker table as an absolute positioned layout. Center the community cards and pot. Map seats to specific degrees/positions around an oval container. Avoid generic grid layouts for the live table.
Use CSS Grid for the lobby to maintain high density, simulating a professional data dashboard.
Incorporate lucide-react icons for settings, bankroll, chat, and filters.
Avoid using generic Shadcn cards for the main poker table view; instead, build custom DOM elements mimicking felt and chip stacks.
For the slider in the action panel, customize Shadcn's slider or build a custom one with an integrated text input for exact bet amounts.

Install the required fonts via Google Fonts in the index.html or global CSS (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;600&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;600&display=swap');).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so build components for .js files not for .tsx files.
